text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - elevated 5xx/504 spike observed across api-gateway-prod. Paging on-call. Symptoms: surge of 504s + high tail latency. Start ~2026-03-15T09:58Z.
jules: taking pager, oncall here. first pass: what regions / routes?
maya: seeing it in us-west-2 and eu-west-1, route = /v1/generate + /v1/embeddings, also some internal healthchecks showing timeouts
pagerduty-bot: Metric summary: 5xx rate up ~30% on ingress for last 6m; error budget at risk.
samir: support: noisy customer reports, ticket queue increasing. I’ll draft an initial customer ping for affected tenants.
eric: quick log peek -> upstream timeouts + retry amplification. sample log below.
maya: pasting relevant lines from api-gateway router logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:58:12Z api-gateway router=ingress cid=0xA12F request=/v1/generate status=504 upstream=runtime-12 attempts=4 rt=15023ms
2026-03-15T09:58:12Z runtime-12 worker pid=73 trace=0xA12F recv=4990ms process=10005ms err=timeout
2026-03-15T09:58:13Z api-gateway router=ingress cid=0xA13B request=/v1/embeddings status=504 upstream=runtime-03 attempts=3 rt=12012ms
```
jules: correlation id 0xA12F appears across multiple services. If gateway is retrying, and client is also retrying, we're amplifying load.
eric: hypothesis: recent router change (PR #9876) rolled back incorrectly and re-enabled aggressive retry policy on a few routes. Combined with aggressive client retries -> thundering retry waterfall.
maya: running trace join on cid=0xA12F -> shows 3 concurrent attempts active for same request id.
olivia: can we disable gateway retries on the affected route as a hotfix? prefer quick flip to stop amplification.
jules: initiating hotfix: `redwoodctl route update api-gateway-prod --path /v1 --retries 0` (pushing to prod now).
pagerduty-bot: Hotfix deploy started by jules.
maya: also scaling runtime pool +20% to give capacity for inflight requests. running `kubectl scale deployment runtime --replicas=$(expr $(kubectl get deploy runtime -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}') + 4)`
eric: searching logs for attempts>1 pattern; output sample counts below:
```
attempts=1 -> 3500
attempts=2 -> 4100
attempts=3 -> 850
```
maya: hotfix applied, retries=0. rolling config change completed.
jules: monitoring metrics now — initial signal: 5xx rate down from ~30% -> ~6% within 2m. latency tail improving.
samir: customer impact update: flagged 8 customers with >5% error rate in last 10m, sending P0 outreach now.
olivia: capture notes for RCA: save router config diff, PR history, and traces for sample cids. PR #9876 referenced as suspect.
eric: immediate root-cause hypothesis: mis-rollback of PR #9876 re-introduced aggressive retry policy; client SDKs also doing retries without jitter -> retry storm.
maya: saving trace bundle and raw logs: s3://redwood-incident-archives/1930054321/trace-bundle.tar.gz (includes router logs, runtime logs, and span links).
jules: timeline (draft):
- 09:57:48Z: small blip in runtime latency
- 09:58:03Z: ingress 5xx spike begins
- 09:58:30Z: Pager triggered, on-call paged
- 09:59:10Z: initial triage, correlation ids identified
- 10:02:05Z: retry-policy hotfix deployed (retries=0)
- 10:04:30Z: 5xx rate back down to baseline-ish
eric: mitigation summary: disable gateway retries, scale runtime briefly, notify customers, preserved logs/traces for RCA. root cause hypothesis above.
maya: I'll own the RCA write-up; will include preserved traces, timeline, config diffs, and a runbook change to prevent route-level retry defaults that can amplify client retries.
samir: support will follow up with targeted customer comms and open follow-up tickets for any customers that saw impact.
oncall-ops: Reminder: attach span links, saved query IDs, and sample correlation ids (0xA12F, 0xA13B) to INC-1930054321.
jules: handing off post-mitigation monitoring to maya — I'll be available on-call override for 30m. :thumbsup:
maya: ack, taking primary for post-incident checks and RCA. will add hypothesis matrix and assign owners.
jules: closing initial incident command. keep channel for updates. :white_check_mark:
